messages.subject: Non-reactive message in output
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to get a message in my output which is only shown when a particular option is selected in a radio button and when the action button is clicked. However, the message can be shown by changing the radio button without clicking the action button. I use the action button because I do not want the application to be executed at the start. Below is a simplified and reproducible example of my code. More concrete and referring to my code: what I want to achieve is that when method A is selected and I click the action button that the message is not printed and that the message is printed when I select method B and click the action button. What now happens is that the message is already printed when I select method B in the radio button, but I want that it is only shown when I select method B and the action button is clicked.

Hopefully my explanation is clear.

Thank you in advance,
Robbie 


library(shiny)

server <- function(input, output) {
  
  observe({
    if(input$action == 0) {
      return()
    }
    
    isolate({
      
      output$text <- renderPrint({
          
          "Message"
          
        })
        
    }) # isolate
  }) # observe
  
}

ui <- shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Test app"),
  
  fluidRow(
    column(4,
           wellPanel(
             
             radioButtons("method", label = "Select method", choices = list("A", "B")),
             
             br(),
             
             actionButton("action", "action")#,
             
           ) #wellPanel
    ), #column
    
    mainPanel(
      
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.method == 'B'",
        
        conditionalPanel(
          condition = "input.action > 0",
          
          verbatimTextOutput('text')
          
        ) # ConditionalPanel action
      ) # conditionalPanel method
    ) # mainPanel
    
  ) # fluidRow
  
))

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

messages.subject: Re: Non-reactive message in output
parts:
Hi,

does that not work? renderPrint is only called when the action button is pressed and when at the same time method=='B' then "Message B" is shown.

server <- function(input, output) {
    
  output$text <- renderPrint({
    input$action
    if (isolate(input$method)=='B') {
       "Message B"
    }
  })
}

  Best Sigbert
